forecast_authority_leakage_findings.FUNCTION_OR_PATH: Task8 persisted availability binding at the Task9 application and replay-pipeline boundaries
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.CURRENT_BEHAVIOR: Exact replay requires persisted Task8 availability, loads MaturityDailyPredictionModel.created_at, injects it into trusted source-ref and verification evidence, and checks it against the exact forecast cutoff.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.LEAKAGE_VECTOR: Closed: caller omission cannot bypass persisted database authority, and caller-provided duplicate timestamps must match the persisted created_at.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.REQUIRED_MINIMUM_FIX: Closed by PR #190; no further implementation gap remains for Task8 persisted availability authority.

forecast_authority_leakage_findings.CURRENT_BEHAVIOR: Checks known_at and source_available_at and conditionally checks observation_date.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.LEAKAGE_VECTOR: Weather values can omit observation_date and source_ref is an unconstrained dictionary; no stable weather source/hash binding is required.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.REQUIRED_MINIMUM_FIX: Make weather source selection carry observation date, source version/hash, and source-class-specific cutoff evidence.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.TEST_REQUIRED: Future weather observation with omitted or post-cutoff observation metadata must fail closed.

forecast_authority_leakage_findings.CURRENT_BEHAVIOR: Residual prediction accepts caller-supplied destination_factory_category; planning service separately supports as-of effective plan selection.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.LEAKAGE_VECTOR: The current residual path does not require the as-of selected plan row/version/hash, so a caller could supply a current category with only generic timestamps.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.REQUIRED_MINIMUM_FIX: Bind planning feature construction to the as-of plan identity/version/hash and reject post-cutoff revisions.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.TEST_REQUIRED: A plan revision available after cutoff must be rejected even when its generic FeatureValue timestamps are present.

forecast_authority_leakage_findings.FUNCTION_OR_PATH: Residual prediction request and model artifact loading
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.CURRENT_BEHAVIOR: Loads explicit model_run_id, task9_run_id, and optional feature_analytics_build_run_id; no latest model lookup is used by the entrypoint.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.LEAKAGE_VECTOR: No current/latest substitution was found, but an explicitly selected model_run_id can refer to an artifact created after the historical forecast cutoff unless a separate availability authority rejects it.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.REQUIRED_MINIMUM_FIX: Keep explicit-ID loading and enforce model artifact available_at <= exact forecast_cutoff_at; ensure any future fallback remains fail-closed and provenance-visible.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.TEST_REQUIRED: Existing prediction-authority tests must continue to reject missing or mismatched explicit artifact identities; a future model_run_id must be blocked when its artifact availability is after the exact forecast cutoff.

forecast_authority_leakage_findings.FUNCTION_OR_PATH: Exact forecast cutoff resolution and residual FeatureValue visibility
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.CURRENT_BEHAVIOR: Replay resolves HarvestStateRun.forecast_effective_cutoff_at, passes the exact cutoff to prediction/training visibility, and rejects known_at or source_available_at after it.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.LEAKAGE_VECTOR: Closed: same-day post-cutoff FeatureValue timestamps are rejected while equality remains visible; legacy EOD exists only for non-replay runs without persisted cutoff.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.REQUIRED_MINIMUM_FIX: Closed by PR #189; exact cutoff propagation and post-cutoff rejection are covered by current code/tests.

forecast_authority_leakage_findings.FUNCTION_OR_PATH: Residual model artifact historical availability authority
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.CURRENT_BEHAVIOR: The prediction path requires an explicit model_run_id and does not perform a latest-model lookup.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.LEAKAGE_VECTOR: A model artifact created after the historical forecast cutoff can be explicitly selected by model_run_id unless another upstream authority rejects it.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.REQUIRED_MINIMUM_FIX: Enforce MODEL_ARTIFACT_AVAILABLE_AT <= FORECAST_CUTOFF_AT or an equivalent historical model authority contract.
forecast_authority_leakage_findings.TEST_REQUIRED: An explicit future model_run_id must be blocked.

minimum_implementation_gaps: Enforce historical residual model artifact availability at or before the exact forecast_cutoff_at.
Require weather-specific observation date and stable source/version/hash provenance.
Require planning-specific as-of effective plan identity/version/hash provenance.
Retain ANALYTICS_FACTORY_RECEIPT as an explicit evidence taxonomy gap until S1 source-class governance accepts it.
latest_or_current_fallback_findings: No explicit latest/current model fallback was found in the residual prediction entrypoint; requests load explicit model_run_id and task9_run_id.
No latest/current fallback was found in the AnalyticsBuildRun feature path; absent or blocked features cause a visibility failure rather than selecting a current build.

Explicit model_run_id selection is not equivalent to historical model availability at the exact forecast cutoff; no future artifact substitution was observed, but the availability control is not enforced.
The remaining blockers are exact cutoff propagation and source-class-specific availability/provenance evidence, not an observed latest/current substitution.
overall_block_reasons: Task9 structural feature evidence is partial because Task8 prediction source availability is represented by an as-of date and lineage identities, not an explicit source_available_at authority.
Current residual weather supplemental inputs lack enforced weather-specific observation-date and stable source/hash binding.
Current residual planning supplemental input lacks enforced as-of plan version/hash binding.
